# ClearStack Data — Apify Actors, n8n Templates & MCP Tools

> Lightweight, HTTP-only Apify Actors and ready-to-import n8n workflow templates for competitor ad intelligence, public Telegram channel monitoring, direct ATS career-site job search (25,787 employers), EU VAT/KYB verification, and European public procurement monitoring.

- Developer Profile: https://apify.com/clearstack-data
- GitHub Templates Repo: https://github.com/Wordhalm/clearstack-data-automation-templates
- Apify MCP Server: https://mcp.apify.com

## Actors

- [Google Ads Transparency Center Scraper & Competitor Monitor](https://apify.com/clearstack-data/google-ads-transparency-scraper): Bulk extract ads by domain, advertiser ID, or URL with region/format/date filters, EU DSA targeting details, and incremental `onlyNewSinceLastRun` monitoring. ($0.002/run + $1.20/1,000 ads)
- [Telegram Public Channel Scraper & Incremental Monitor](https://apify.com/clearstack-data/telegram-public-channel-monitor): Scrape public Telegram channels (`t.me/s/`) without login, phone number, or proxies. Extracts posts, views, reactions, media URLs, and supports `onlyNewSinceLastRun` cursor mode. ($0.002/run + $1.50/1,000 posts)
- [Direct Career Site Jobs Search (25K+ Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby)](https://apify.com/clearstack-data/career-site-jobs-search): Search live direct-apply jobs across 25,787 employers on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and SmartRecruiters public JSON APIs. Built for Claude MCP job search and B2B hiring signals. ($0.002/run + $1.50/1,000 jobs)
- [EU Company KYB, VAT (VIES) & Official Registry Enricher](https://apify.com/clearstack-data/eu-company-kyb-enricher): Validate EU-27 VAT via VIES and enrich companies across France DINUM SIRENE/RNE, Switzerland Zefix, Norway Brreg, Finland PRH/YTJ, and GLEIF LEI with zero API keys. ($4.00/1,000 companies)
- [EU TED, France BOAMP & UK Public Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/clearstack-data/eu-public-tenders-monitor): Unified daily monitor across official EU TED v3, France BOAMP, and UK Find a Tender OCDS APIs. ($2.00/1,000 tenders)
- [Website AI-Readiness (GEO), SEO & Tech Stack Auditor](https://apify.com/clearstack-data/ai-readiness-geo-auditor): Bulk check `llms.txt`, GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot robots rules, structured data, technical SEO, security headers, and tech stack. ($4.00/1,000 domains)

## Clay Recipes

- [Clay recipes (Run Apify Actor JSON inputs)](https://github.com/Wordhalm/clearstack-data-automation-templates/blob/main/clay-recipes/README.md): hiring signal per account (Career Site Jobs Search), Google Ads activity per domain (Google Ads Transparency Scraper), EU VAT and registry check (EU Company KYB Enricher).

## Free Tools

- [ATS Job Board Finder](https://wordhalm.github.io/ats-job-board-finder/): which ATS a company uses (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters) and its open roles, for 25,787 companies. Index downloadable as JSON.
